newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras profit seen rising on rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Telebras profit seen rising on rate hike.

text.p: Profits at Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras in 1997 are likely to rise further after the government set higher-than-expected new telephone rates, analysts said.

Analysts said Telebras, whose 1996 profits had already soared following a first rate restructuring, would benefit again from what the government said was the second and final stage of a restructuring of tariffs in the telecommunications sector.
"The impact of the new rate structure in Telebras and its subsidiaries will be higher than we had imagined," said Marcelo Molica, telecom analyst at Rio-based investment bank Banco Icatu.
Molica said he expects Telebras net consolidated earnings to rise nearly 50 percent this year, compared with last year's 2.756 billion reais net profit.
Icatu had projected Telebras' profits would rise 30 percent over 1996's earnings.
